name: Gate USD
oneLiner: Gate USD is Gate's account-linked yield product, subscribed 1:1 with USDT, USDC, or USD1; Gate claims Treasury and stablecoin backing and pays daily GUSD.
collateral: Gate attributes GUSD returns to its own ecosystem revenue alongside tokenized Treasury RWAs and yield-bearing stablecoin assets, but publishes no instrument-level allocation, named reserve vehicle, custodian, or product-specific reserve reconciliation
pegMechanism: Users subscribe 1:1 with USDT, USDC, or USD1 on Gate. Returns accrue from subscription and are distributed daily in GUSD. Gate quotes a fixed 1 GUSD = 1 USDT/USDC/USD1 conversion rate rather than an accruing NAV. Redemption offers a fast path Gate describes as typically credited within five minutes and a standard path credited on D+3, with the 1:1 fee-free exit limited to the original subscription asset and to a per-currency fee-free quota Gate has not sized; redemptions beyond that quota or into a different asset carry a fee shown only at redemption time

notices.title: Circulating-supply caveat
notices.message: Pharos inherits GUSD supply from DefiLlama, whose current series tracks the full Ethereum token supply. Gate subscription figures and CoinGecko circulating supply are lower, so the displayed market cap should not be read as independently reconciled circulating supply.

notices.title: Jurisdictional access restriction
notices.message: Gate states that users in the UK and other restricted regions cannot access the GUSD Flexible US Treasury product. GUSD redemption is available only to Gate account holders in permitted jurisdictions.
